gates.title: Install the workspace app on the Enterprise Grid org
gates.detail: Create a Slack app from slack/manifest.json and install it on the Enterprise Grid org, not on a single workspace. Grant it to workspaces created later, and approve it if an admin must. Reinstall after a manifest change so the new scopes are granted. This app creates the workspace, invites users, and stages channels. People do not message it.

gates.title: Store the org-admin Slack token
gates.detail: Keep the org-admin user token in the coding agent's secret store as SLACK_ADMIN_TOKEN. The shared cast is Alex, Sam, Jordan, Riley, Casey, and Jamie. Persona tokens use SLACK_TOKEN_ALEX, SLACK_TOKEN_SAM, SLACK_TOKEN_JORDAN, SLACK_TOKEN_RILEY, SLACK_TOKEN_CASEY, and SLACK_TOKEN_JAMIE. Reuse these users for later demos. Keep the tokens out of git.

gates.title: Make Alex a Frontline Member
gates.detail: Turn on the Frontline add-on. Alex is a Frontline Member with exactly #onboarding-alex, #store-stockholm, and #announcements, and they are out of #general and #random. Sam and Jordan are Full Members. Riley, Casey, and Jamie are the Gothenburg, Oslo, and Copenhagen managers. Use separate Chrome profiles for Sam and Jordan, and test phone mirroring for Alex. Do this before the webinar. The live demo does not include an admin invite.

gates.title: Build the workflows and test them on a phone
gates.detail: In Workflow Builder, create I've read the guide in #onboarding-alex and Report low stock in every store channel. I've read the guide ticks Alex's row on the New starters List. Report low stock posts in the store channel and in #nordics-stock-requests, which Alex is not in. Test both as Alex on a phone, including a photo from the camera roll, and open Onboarding - Alex, Stockholm on that phone. Then bookmark them.

gates.title: Post any staged lines the tokens did not send
gates.detail: Each staged message is posted as that person. Weekly reports post as Jordan until a bot token can send them as Northpeak Reports. Where a persona token is missing, sign in as that person and paste the line from the dry-run. Leave Jordan's transfer reply unsent until Alex has raised the low stock. Put a photo of a near-empty rail in Alex's camera roll before the webinar.

gates.title: Pre-record Alex's beat
gates.detail: Record Beat 1 on the phone as a fallback before the webinar. The live path is still Alex in Slack, with no huddle.
